That manual CLI smoke test was also blocked in this sandbox (shell syntax it can't statically approve). The automated test suite (`npm test`, 9/9 passing, including the two new color tests) already exercises the actual logic, so I'll rely on that instead of further shell probing.

**What changed:** In `src/commands.js`, `list()` now wraps a habit's line in ANSI green (`\x1b[32m…\x1b[0m`) when its current streak is 3 or more days; `cli.js` is unchanged since it just prints whatever `list()` returns. Added two tests in `test/commands.test.js` covering the 3+-day green case and the under-3 uncolored case. Full suite passes (9/9).

One thing worth knowing: colored output isn't suppressed for non-TTY targets (e.g., piping to a file) or `NO_COLOR` — I kept it minimal since that wasn't asked for, but say the word if you want that added.
